title: CP-1 DesiredState v1alpha1
description: Body of GET /api/v1/devices/{deviceId}/deployments (and desired.json in an offline bundle). Margo ApplicationDeployment shape with registered x-flex-* extensions. Derived from what flexengine2.core.reconciler reads and flexengine2.testing.fakecloud writes.
$comment: Compatibility (v1alpha1): changes are additive only (new optional fields, new enum values such as a new driver profile, new registered x-flex-* keys). Removing or retyping a field, or making an optional field required, needs v1alpha2. Objects owned by flex (DesiredState, x-flex-activation, its window) are closed. Margo-owned objects (ApplicationDeployment, metadata, spec, deploymentProfile, component) accept unknown Margo keys (the engine ignores them) but reject every unknown key starting with 'x-'. Semantic rules not expressible here (checked by flexengine2.contracts): deployment ids unique; metadata.deviceId, when present, equals deviceId; x-flex-dependsOn names other deployments of this document, without duplicates or cycles.

manifestVersion.description: Strictly increasing per device. The engine refuses a lower value, and an equal value with a different body (rollback protection).

deployments.description: Complete set. A deployment absent here is removed from the device.

DeviceId.description: Device identity. A child device behind a gateway (MCU) is addressed as '<gatewayId>.<child>' (e.g. panda.portenta) and has its own DesiredState; the gateway's engine process runs the child's engine (see-thru). The id is used in URL paths (fakecloud matches [\w.-]+).

DeploymentId.description: metadata.id: stable across versions; identity for update, rollback and removal; used in URL paths, container names (flex_<device>_<id>) and driver state.

DriverProfile.description: Driver SPI profile (CP-5). One profile per driver; the engine refuses a deployment whose profile has no driver on this device ('no driver for <profile>'). os-rauc (EV-17): whole-OS A/B update with RAUC. arduino-ota (EV-38): flexNode-arduino board firmware over the Portenta OTA path (parameter `board` names the board when the driver has several). New profiles (plc-codesys-as, ...) are added here as they ship.

Parameters.description: Deployment parameters. Flat map of scalars: container/native drivers pass them as env FLEX_PARAM_<NAME upper-cased>=<value>; mcu-module as 'k=v;...' to the module (keys starting with '_' are not sent); applab splits '<instance>.<name>' keys into {instance: {name: value}} (bare names under '*'); plc-verify reads 'plc' (target override). Typing against the release descriptor's parameter list (Margo M11) is beta (EV-25).

propertyNames.$comment: Names starting with '_' are reserved for the engine; only registered ones are allowed.

_interfaceHash.description: Reserved: the FLEX01 hash the deployment expects. Checked in preflight by mcu-module (module header) and plc-verify (release descriptor).

plc.description: plc-verify only: PLC target to verify (overrides flex-plc.json target), e.g. 'panda/cx' or 'opta'.

ActivationRequirement.description: Either a safe-state signal name (must be true in the device's safe-state provider, e.g. machine_parked, operator_confirmed) or 'plc:<deploymentId>[@<FLEX01 hash>]': hold until the plc-verify driver has verified that deployment (at that hash) on this device.

Activation.description: Activation gate (FE-S6 / D1a hold), applied to installs, updates and removals. The deployment stays Pending with the gate's reason until it opens. For x-flex-safetyClass != none the engine adds machine_parked and operator_confirmed implicitly.

window.description: UTC time-of-day window [start, end); end < start wraps over midnight.

DependsOn.description: Deployment ordering on this device (EV-42): this deployment is installed or updated only once every listed deployment of the same desired state runs its desired release (condition started) and is healthy (condition healthy, the default); until then it stays Pending ('held: waiting for <ids>', FE-GATE-004) on its previous version. Removals run in reverse order (a dependency is removed after its dependents, FE-GATE-005). A failed or rolled-back dependency holds its dependents (no cascade rollback). Semantic rules (flexengine2.contracts): every id names another deployment of the same desired state, no duplicates, no cycles; a document that breaks them is refused as a whole (FE-DS-006).

deployment.description: metadata.id of another deployment in this desired state.

condition.description: started: the dependency is committed at its desired release (Installed, any health); healthy: committed and its last observed health is healthy (compose service_started / service_healthy).

repository.description: oci://<registry host>/<repository>. The engine strips the scheme and host and fetches /v2/<repository>/manifests|blobs|referrers/<digest> from its configured apiUrl (CP-3).

revision.description: Release version (SemVer); reported back as status.version.

digest.description: sha256 of the release manifest bytes: the identity of what runs.

type.$comment: Margo also defines compose and helm; the engine supports custom only (capabilities: supportedDeploymentTypes). compose is EV-27 (additive).

components.$comment: The engine reads components[0] only; a second component would be ignored silently, so v1alpha1 forbids it.

x-flex-safetyClass.description: Default none. Must equal the safetyClass in the signed release descriptor (else 'safety class mismatch'); safety-relevant needs a two-person approval in the release signature (CP-4) and implies the FE-S6 interlock.
